blurb: Guests sail along Narragansett Bay and Newport Harbor passing landmarks like Fort Adams and Clingstone. The schooner is a classic 101' two-masted gaff schooner with topsails, accommodating up to 68 passengers. Various sail packages include options like a Lobster Boil & Sunset Sail and Wine & Cheese sail with specific food and beverage policies.

quotes.text: Always a blast with the crew on the Schooner Aurora! Ben is a great captain and so friendly and knowledgeable of the area. We did the Wine and Cheese cruise and was able to take our group of 11 friends on and we had a blast!!! Last summer we did the Lobster Boil sunset cruise and it is just as fun. It’s a great excursion to try at least once a summer whether you are a local Rhody or spending your vacation in Newport!
So much fun on our visit to Newport ! The crew was great and answered any questions that we had . We met some great people and enjoyed some delicious cheese, crackers and fruit!! Wonderful evening!!

An afternoon cruise aboard the Schooner Aurora was part of our niece’s wedding festivities, and it was great fun! All the wedding guests were comfortably accommodated on board, and enjoyed drinks and snacks while sailing around Newport Harbor. The crew were very friendly and knowledgeable about the area, so could share restaurant and activity recommendations while tending to hoisting or adjusting sails. We had an absolute ball—what gorgeous scenery!
